// ZipText Adaptive Representation Chunk Transformer
export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

export async function processChunk(buffer: Uint8Array, config: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ChunkDescriptor> {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    const hash = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return {
        index: Number(config.index || 0),
        rawSize: buffer.byteLength,
        compressedSize: buffer.byteLength,
        codec: 'raw',
        checksum: hash
    };
}

// ZipText Adaptive Representation Chunk Transformer
export interface ChunkDescriptor {
    readonly index: number;
    readonly rawSize: number;
    readonly compressedSize: number;
    readonly codec: 'raw' | 'zlib' | 'bz2' | 'lzma' | 'lz4';
    readonly checksum: string;
}
